result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but there is a clearly broken text label in the 'Popular right now' section that garbles the delivery-time and fee info for Tokumaru Ramen Bar.

issues.description: The info line under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' reads '25-35Ddelivery • Ramen', which looks malformed: the time unit is missing/broken and 'delivery' is concatenated to an stray 'D'. This makes the card look glitchy and harder to read.
issues.suggestion: Fix the label formatting so it displays the correct delivery time and fee with proper separators/spacing, e.g., '25-35 min • delivery €0 • Ramen' or the localized equivalent.

issues.description: The bottom 'Popular right now' pizza card is partially cut off by the bottom navigation bar, hiding its restaurant name and details until the user scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the last card has enough bottom padding/margin so it can be fully scrolled into view above the navigation bar.
